tasks.title: Unify Check review repair policy
tasks.description: Make WorkflowRun Check stage definitions the single authoritative source for `review-passed` repair budget and `fix-review-findings` scheduling. Remove or delegate the legacy CheckStageRunner repair policy so retry and repair scheduling cannot expose conflicting max-attempt semantics.
acceptanceCriteria: WorkflowRun and CheckStageRunner no longer expose conflicting `review-passed` repair maxAttempts values
A failed `review-passed` check schedules `fix-review-findings` only while the authoritative repair budget remains
Retrying an exhausted failed Check review does not append a new `fix-review-findings` task
Existing re-review invalidation after completed `fix-review-findings` still resets `ai-review` and `review-passed` for follow-up review
Typecheck passes
tasks.notes: This task produces the policy fact consumed by every later task. Preserve compatibility for reading historical task ids, but new repair scheduling should use `fix-review-findings`.

tasks.title: Project Check repair state
tasks.description: Add a computed Check-only repair state to stage-state responses. The projection must summarize attempts used/max/remaining, repair availability, last repair task and status, follow-up review status, stop reason, and unresolved review summary without adding a persistence table.
acceptanceCriteria: `GET /api/issues/:number/stage-state` includes `checkRepair` for Check stage when review repair evidence exists
`checkRepair` derives attempts from `fix-review-findings` task history and derives verdict from `review-passed`, not from repair task success
A completed `fix-review-findings` followed by failed `review-passed` projects last repair completed and follow-up review failed
An exhausted Check review projects zero remaining attempts and stop reason `max-repair-attempts-reached`
`blockedReason` remains concise and is not overloaded with detailed repair state
Typecheck passes
tasks.notes: Use a tolerant summary extractor for review output. The read model should work for WorkflowRun-backed state and best-effort legacy fallback when enough task/check rows exist.

tasks.title: Expose explicit Check recovery intents
tasks.description: Expose API/client actions that distinguish checkpoint retry, review-only rerun, and review-findings repair for Check review failures. The repair action must append or reuse `fix-review-findings` only when repair is available, and review-only rerun must not imply another repair attempt.
acceptanceCriteria: Checkpoint retry remains available as checkpoint recovery and does not schedule new repair when repair budget is exhausted
A Check review-only rerun action invalidates or reruns review verification without appending `fix-review-findings`
A Check repair action schedules or reuses `fix-review-findings` when `checkRepair.repairAvailable` is true
Repair action is idempotent for pending or running `fix-review-findings` work
API responses and errors use user-intent wording such as retry checkpoint, rerun review, or fix review findings
Typecheck passes
tasks.notes: Prefer narrow Check-specific endpoints or application-service actions over changing `/retry` semantics. Do not create unlimited automatic repair loops.

tasks.title: Render Check repair decision surface
tasks.description: Update Issue Detail to render a compact Check repair panel from `checkRepair` and show recovery buttons by user intent. The UI must clearly distinguish repair task completion from review gate pass and explain repair exhaustion or remaining repair availability.
acceptanceCriteria: Blocked Check review issues show auto-fix status, attempts used/max/remaining, last repair status, follow-up review status, and stop reason when `checkRepair` is present
A completed `fix-review-findings` followed by failed `review-passed` is displayed as last repair completed and follow-up review failed
Repair exhaustion copy states that auto-fix will not continue automatically and recommends manual takeover or review-only rerun as appropriate
Actions are labeled `Fix review findings`, `Rerun review only`, and `Retry checkpoint` instead of presenting ambiguous `Retry` as the primary review-failure action
Action success invalidates issue, stage-state, workflow-run, and agent-status queries
Typecheck passes
tasks.notes: Keep the UI change local to Check failure surfaces. Do not redesign the whole issue detail page.

tasks.title: Add Check repair regressions
tasks.description: Add regression coverage for the backend projection, recovery actions, and frontend display semantics. The tests should prove repair exhaustion is not misleadingly retried and that repair completion plus failed follow-up review is presented as an attempt outcome plus failed gate.
acceptanceCriteria: Backend tests prove stage-state projects attempts used/max, repair availability, last repair status, follow-up review status, and stop reason
Backend tests prove retrying an exhausted failed Check review does not create another `fix-review-findings` task
Frontend tests prove `Repair task completed` and `Follow-up review failed` are displayed together for completed repair followed by failed `review-passed`
Frontend tests prove exhausted repair budget shows non-automatic continuation guidance and does not make ambiguous `Retry` the primary review-failure action
Relevant tests pass
Typecheck passes
tasks.notes: Prefer focused unit/component tests over broad LLM or browser E2E tests. This task depends on the completed API and UI behavior from earlier tasks.
